description: US domestic wire transfer using Fedwire system
test_coverage: OUR charge bearer (ordering customer pays all charges)
US domestic banks (Bank of America and JPMorgan Chase)
Block 3 with MUR (tag 108) for Fedwire reference
Block 3 with UETR (tag 121) for transaction tracking
Field 70 (Remittance Information) with purchase order reference
business_rules_expected_to_pass: BICs must be valid ISO 9362 format
UETR must be valid UUID format
notes: Typical US domestic wire transfer. Uses Fedwire system for same-day settlement. OUR charge bearer means ordering customer (ACME Corporation) pays all fees. No IBANs as US doesn't use IBAN system - uses domestic account numbers instead. Bank of America to JPMorgan Chase routing. MUR field contains Fedwire reference. Amount is USD 50,000 which is common for B2B commercial payments in the US.
